summary: Tested the new-tab Dropbox OAuth flow and the HTML callback result page. Backend: 37 passed, 1 skipped (an intentionally obsolete test). Callback returns 200 text/html for all three cases (error=access_denied, bogus state, no params) with the correct title, reason text and a 'Back to admin' link to FRONTEND_URL/admin, and the reason is HTML-escaped. UI: admin login works. Clicking dropbox-connect-button opens a new tab at www.dropbox.com/oauth2/authorize with client_id, state, redirect_uri and token_access_type=offline. The original tab stays on /admin and shows the info toast 'Finish signing in to Dropbox in the new tab. This page updates by itself.' The callback page renders and 'Back to admin' goes to /admin. The home page renders. Did not sign in to Dropbox, so the success path (connected toast after polling, window.close) was not tested.

issues: Browser tab title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App'; set it to Cooked World

action_items: Optional: clear the waitForConnection interval on unmount and avoid starting several intervals if Connect is clicked more than once
Optional: the callback page posts window.opener.postMessage({dropbox}) but DropboxCard does not listen for it. Add a message listener for instant feedback, or drop the postMessage

Optional: the window.top.location fallback can throw SecurityError in a sandboxed iframe without allow-top-navigation. The catch then shows a generic error toast; show a clear message such as 'Open the app in its own tab to connect Dropbox'
critical_code_review_comments: DropboxCard.connect opens about:blank synchronously before the await, which correctly avoids popup blockers
Polling (every 3s, up to 100 tries) is not tied to the component lifecycle, so it can leak after navigating away
_done_page escapes the reason text (verified with a script-tag payload)

The success path needs a real Dropbox sign-in by the user.
